declarations.name: markdownToHTML
declarations.description: Renders a page editor value (Markdown) as HTML, with real nested lists, without an editor on the page.

A page editor for long text, in the spirit of Notion but with only what makes writing faster: headings, lists,
to-dos, quotes, code blocks with syntax colours, dividers, links, and eight named text and background colours.

Formatting is reachable three ways, all running the same commands: Markdown typed as you go (`# `, `- `, `[] `,
`> `, three backticks, `**bold**`; Backspace right after undoes it), a `/` menu (or the `+` button on an empty line),
and a toolbar over selected text. On touch screens a format bar sits above the keyboard.

The value is GitHub-flavoured Markdown, with inline HTML for underline and colours, and the element is a form
control. Code blocks load their syntax colours on demand from shiki, only when a block names a language.

members.name: value
members.description: The page as Markdown: headings, lists, to-dos, quotes, fenced code, dividers, emphasis and links, with `<u>`, `<span data-color>` and `<mark data-color>` for underline and colours.

members.name: name
members.description: Name submitted with the form.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the page.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name forwarded from the host.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Shown while the page is empty.

members.name: blocks
members.description: Space-separated block types the writer may use (`paragraph heading1 heading2 heading3 bullet ordered todo quote code divider`). The menus and Markdown shortcuts offer only these, and pasted blocks outside the list become text. Empty allows all.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Prevents editing and removes the page from keyboard navigation.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Prevents editing while allowing selection, copying and following links.

members.name: required
members.description: Requires some text for form validation.

members.name: serialized
members.description: The value the editor last produced, so writing it back (v-model) does not reset the page.

members.name: slashMatched
members.description: Length of the last query that still matched something; a few characters past it the menu gives up.

members.name: form
members.description: The containing form, when this control is associated with one.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: text
members.description: The page as plain text, one block per line.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the page.

members.name: isDirty
members.description: Whether the writer has edited the page since the last reset.

members.name: reset
members.description: Restores the `value` attribute.

members.name: setCustomValidity
members.description: Sets or clears a custom validation message.

members.name: setBlock
members.description: Turns the blocks at the selection into `block` (`divider` inserts one). Returns whether anything was applied.

members.name: toggleMark
members.description: Toggles bold, italic, underline, strike or inline code on the selection, or on what is typed next.

members.name: setColor
members.description: Colours the selected text with a named colour, or removes the colour with `null`.

members.name: setBackground
members.description: Gives the selected text a named background colour, or removes it with `null`.

members.name: setLink
members.description: Links the selection (or the link at the caret) to `href`, or removes the link with `null`.

members.name: clearFormatting
members.description: Removes every inline format and colour from the selection.

members.name: toHTML
members.description: The page as HTML, with real `<ul>`/`<ol>` lists, for showing it outside the editor.

members.name: placeholders
members.description: Placeholder text: the element's own on an empty page, a block's name on an empty heading or the line with the caret.

members.name: syncSelectionFromDom
members.description:
ProseMirror learns where a click put the caret from `selectionchange`, which the browser fires asynchronously. A
key pressed before it arrives (Enter, Backspace, a shortcut) would run against the old selection, so read the real one first.

members.name: domSelection

type.text: { anchorNode: Node; anchorOffset: number; focusNode: Node; focusOffset: number } | null

members.description:
The caret and selection inside the shadow root. The standard way is `getComposedRanges` with this shadow root
(Chromium, WebKit, Firefox), whose `direction` tells the anchor from the focus. WebKit's `shadowRoot.getSelection()`
can lag behind a selection set from script, so it is only the fallback for browsers without composed ranges.

members.name: parsePastedText
members.description: Pasted plain text is read as Markdown; its first and last lines join the line being written when they are text.

members.name: filterSlice
members.description: Blocks `blocks` does not allow become text when pasted.

members.name: applyColor
members.description: Applies a named colour to the selection; with no selection, to the whole block when `block` is set, and to what is typed next.

members.name: linkRange
members.description: The range a link edit applies to: the selection, or the whole link around the caret.

members.name: openTurnInto
members.description: Opens the block menu for the current block, without a typed `/` (the format bar's Aa button).

members.name: insertSlash
members.description: Inserts `/` at the caret (on a new line when the line has text) and opens the menu: the `+` button.

members.name: updatePlus
members.description: The `+` button sits in the gutter of the empty line that holds the caret.

members.name: updateBar
members.description: On touch screens a format bar sits on top of the on-screen keyboard while the page has focus.

members.name: stopNativeEditing
members.description: Stops the editing surface's own `input` / `beforeinput`: the element fires its own `input` with `value` up to date.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired on each edit, after `value` is updated.

events.name: format-change
events.description: Fired when the block or the formatting at the selection changes. Does not bubble.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the editor loses focus after its value changed.
